claim: EUSIPCO 2026 (34th European Signal Processing Conference) runs 31 August – 4 September 2026 at Concertgebouw Brugge, organised by KU Leuven.
quote: The 34th edition of EUSIPCO will take place in the beautiful historic city of Bruges from August 31 to September 4, 2026. The conference venue is Concertgebouw Brugge in the city center.

claim: EUSIPCO 2026 final paper revision deadline is 2 June 2026; the technical programme covers all areas of signal processing.
quote: Final Paper Revision Deadline: Tuesday, 2 June 2026. EUSIPCO 2026 will feature a comprehensive technical program addressing all the latest developments in research and technology for signal processing.

claim: Building Bruges is a 575-member software-developer community founded by Peter Morlion, running irregular talks and workshops in Bruges.
quote: Building Bruges. 575 members. Organizer: Peter Morlion and 2 others. We want to get together with software developers in Bruges, so we can get to know each other and learn from each other.

claim: Howest Tech&Meet runs free Tuesday-evening talks on software, AI and cybersecurity at the Brugge campus next to the railway station; registration required.
quote: Tech&Meet sessions usually take place on Tuesday evenings at the Howest Brugge campus next to the Railway Station, and are free to attend subject to registration.

claim: Howest's 2026 paid masterclasses include 'Industrial Security' (starts 12 February 2026, 8 Thursday evenings) and 'Build Your Own AI Agent with Low-Code' (19 March 2026), both held at the Brugge campus and eligible for Flemish KMO-Portefeuille subsidies.
quote: Masterclass: Industrial Security. Start Date: February 12, 2026. Duration: 8 evening sessions (Thursdays). Masterclass: Build Your Own AI Agent with Low-Code. Date: March 19, 2026. Flemish SMEs may access KMO-Portefeuille subsidies.

claim: Cyber 3 Lab (Rijselstraat 5, Brugge) curates a 2026 calendar that — within 30 km of Knokke — includes a Proxmox migration workshop (26 May, Brugge), an AI keynote (9 June), an OT/ICS Security focus group (17 June, Brugge), an AI & Robotics masterclass (24 June, Oostende), and a Tech BBQ networking event (25 June, Brugge).
quote: May: Proxmox migration workshop (May 26, Brugge). June: AI keynote (June 9), OT/ICS Security Focus Group (June 17, Brugge), AI & Robotics masterclass (June 24, Oostende), Tech BBQ (June 25, Brugge).

claim: Howest International IT Week runs 9–13 March 2026 across the Bruges and Kortrijk campuses with a 'Vibe-Coding Hackathon', keynote talks and workshops on Flutter, ethical hacking and IoT.
quote: Dates: March 9–13, 2026. Locations: Howest campuses in Bruges and Kortrijk. Activities: 'Vibe-Coding Hackathon' – teams tackle real-world challenges using current technologies, International Fair with interactive workshops.

claim: Tech BBQ 2026 takes place Thursday 25 June at Howest building J, Rijselstraat 5, Brugge from 18:00, with a cybersecurity talk on ransomware in healthcare followed by a barbecue (€19 ticket).
quote: Date: Thursday, June 25, 2026 at 6:00 PM. Venue: Howest, J-building. Address: Rijselstraat 5, 8200 Brugge, Belgium. BBQ Meat option: €19.00. Cybersecurity talk by Annelore Van Eeghem on defending healthcare systems against ransomware threats.

claim: InnovOcean Campus is the shared VLIZ/ILVO research site at Jacobsenstraat 1, Oostende — the venue for the 24 June 2026 AI & Robotics masterclass.
quote: The InnovOcean Campus is located at Jacobsenstraat 1 in Oostende. VLIZ moved from the InnovOcean site at Wandelaarkaai to the new InnovOcean Campus at Jacobsenstraat.

claim: Tech Connect 2026 — Howest's flagship alumni Talks & Showcase — is in Kortrijk on 24 June 2026, outside the 30 km radius of Cuines 33.
quote: Wednesday, June 24, 2026, starting at 4:30 p.m. Campus Kortrijk Weide - Building A, Sint-Martens-Latemlaan 2B, 8500 Kortrijk, Belgium.

claim: Connect IT 2026, the largest cross-sector IT event in the region, is on 7 May 2026 at Antwerp Expo — about 95 km from Knokke, outside the 30 km radius.
quote: Event Date: May 7, 2026. Venue & Location: Antwerp Expo, Hall 1 - Entrance 2, Jan van Rijswijcklaan 191, 2020 Antwerp, Belgium.

claim: Knokke-Heist's official tourism event calendar lists markets, sport, music and folklore but no IT or developer conferences.
quote: In the summer, there are almost daily festivities, ranging from markets and folklore to music performances and sporting events.
